holes_found.description: detail_extra internal inconsistency + false impossibility sub-claim (PRE-EXISTING, not introduced by the ISS-3046 patch — verified present in the pre-patch text at commit ac84737^). Paragraph 1 of detail_extra says H(r) can never reach the three distinct heights (9,572 km from Schumann, 9,086 km from model parameterization, and 2,534 km moon altitude) the dome claims it simultaneously reconciles. But paragraph 2 of the SAME field — and the main detail_evidence block — correctly list the dome three reconciled heights as Schumann (~9,500/9,572 km), Polaris (4,750 km), and model parameterization (9,086 km). The moon altitude (2,534 km) is (a) not one of the firmament heights the dome claims H(r) reconciles (it is the separate moon_altitude parameter), and (b) reachable by H(r): H(r)=2,534 km at r=10,469 km, well inside the disc (R=20,015 km) — self-computed r=8619*ln(8537/2534)=10,468.7 km. So the sentence asserts H(r) can never reach a value it plainly reaches on its way down. The core kill (9,572 and 9,086 both exceed sup H(r)=8,537 km) is unaffected and stands, but a dome defender can note our own kill-shot section (i) can not keep its enumerations straight (moon altitude vs Polaris as the third reconciled height) and (ii) makes a demonstrably false impossibility claim for the 2,534 km member (2,534 < 8,537, so it is NOT a supremum violation).
holes_found.recommendation: In detail_extra paragraph 1 replace 2,534 km moon altitude with 4,750 km Polaris so the enumeration matches paragraph 2 and detail_evidence (a single coherent triple: Schumann 9,572 / model-param 9,086 / Polaris 4,750). Note that only 9,572 and 9,086 exceed the 8,537 km supremum; Polaris 4,750 km is the one value H(r) CAN match (and the text already argues its 10% self-inconsistency separately), so if the intent was three exceed-the-max values, drop the third member entirely and say both 9,572 km and 9,086 km exceed the supremum. Either edit removes the false claim and the inter-paragraph contradiction.

kernel_of_truth.description: The ISS-3046 patch itself is a genuine improvement: it correctly closed the c5 advocate-exploitable tension by naming the TM01/TM11 bracket as a Bessel circumferential mode family the dome never invokes and leading with the 8.78 Hz quarter-wave floor (data/wins.json:WIN-002.detail_extra). The underlying dome instinct the WIN attacks also has a kernel — the dome correctly anchors on 7.83 Hz, a real decades-old Schumann-fundamental measurement, and correctly notices that a curved/decaying height profile changes the effective cavity (data/wins.json:WIN-002.detail_evidence).
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: The WIN claim is a 26% aetheric-damping coefficient read off the 10.59->7.83 Hz gap, but 10.59 Hz is Schumann spherical-Earth formula f1=(c/2*pi*a)*sqrt(2), a=6371 km — a globe number — and the dome own geometry floors at 8.78 Hz (self-computed c/(4*8537)=8.779 Hz), never 7.83 (data/wins.json:WIN-002.detail_evidence). The detail_extra enumeration slip flagged in holes_found[0] does not rescue the dome — it is an error in OUR presentation, and correcting it (Polaris 4,750 km for moon altitude 2,534 km) leaves the supremum-violation kill (9,572 and 9,086 > 8,537) fully intact. Verdict Self-Contradicted holds.
